title: Plumeform template gallery (v2)
description: On paper: a heavy two-line heading whose second line is slate, a wrap of small filter pills (the first one solid), then a three-column grid of near-white glass cards, each with a small capital category, a bold name and a quiet detail line, and an arrow that slides in at the corner. Cards lift 2px with a firmer border on hover and rise into view in turn; an underlined link follows.
notes: the filter pills are links (point them at filtered pages); the first is shown as current
